card.name: Time zone codes after clock times
card.fires_on: Time zone abbreviations such as EST, EDT and CEST right after a clock time or date stamp. Also the PM in flow-rate units like L/PM (liters per minute) in equipment text.

modes.label: Time zone after timestamp
modes.description: EST, EDT or CEST placed directly after a time of day in a date line.
modes.example: Tue, 30 Oct 2012, 11:07:11<< EDT>> - How Martian winds make rocks walk

modes.label: PM in flow rates
modes.description: The letters PM ending a flow-rate or pressure unit such as G PM or L PM.
modes.example: (maximum 30 psi, 12 L<<PM>>). Marquest Acorn II ® P
